response.sql: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rental_price_per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating) SELECT rating, avg_replacement_cost, avg_rental_price_per_day, avg_rental_price_per_day / AVG(avg_rental_price_per_day) OVER () AS per_day_price_ratio_to_rating_average FROM rating_averages ORDER BY rating
